sentences.text: 2 16-10-2023 Heard Mr. Rajani Kant Pandey, learned counsel for the petitioners and Mrs. Sharda Kumari learned A.P.P. for the State.

The petitioners apprehend their arrest in connection with Complaint Case No. 93 of 2021/ Reg. No.
1814 of 2022 registered for the offence under Sections 498A/34 of the Indian Penal Code.
The case relates to matrimonial dispute between the husband and wife.

Since the matter relates to matrimonial dispute between petitioner No.1 and the O.P. No.2 and the petitioner No.2 happens to be father-in-law of the complainant/ O.P. No.2 having no criminal antecedent and taking note of the fact that the parties are ready to Patna High Court CR.

MISC. 
No.61281 of 2023(2) dt.16-10-2023 settled their dispute by way of mediation

, this Court directs that Chandan Kumar vs The State Of Bihar on 16 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/191288232/
1 let petitioner No.2., namely, Markandey Bind, in the event of his arrest or surrender before the court below within a period of four weeks, be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 10,000/- (ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Kaimur at Bhabhua in connection with Complaint Case No. 93 of 2021, subject to the conditions laid down under Section 438(2) of the Cr.P.C. as also with the following conditions:-
(1) Petitioner shall co-operate in the trial and shall be properly represented on each and every date fixed by the Court and shall remain physically present as directed by the Court and on his/her absence on two consecutive dates without sufficient reason,
his/her bail bond shall be canceled by the Court below.

entities.text: Chandan Kumar vs The State Of Bihar
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: (2) If the petitioner tampers with the evidence or the witnesses, in that case, the prosecution will be at liberty to move for cancellation of bail.

And, further condition that the court below shall verify the criminal antecedent of the petitioner and in case at any stage, it is found that the petitioner has concealed his criminal antecedent, the court below shall take step for cancellation of bail bond of the petitioner.
However, the acceptance of bail bonds in terms of the above-mentioned order shall not be delayed for purpose of or in the name of verification.

In view of the submission of parties that they are ready to settle their dispute by way of mediation,
the matter is referred to the Patna High Court CR.
MISC . No.61281 of 2023(2) dt.16-10-2023 Mediation and Conciliation Center, Patna High Court.
In view of the submission, let the matter be referred to the Mediation and Conciliation Center, Patna High Court, Patna.

Both the parties are directed to appear before the Mediation and Conciliation Centre, Patna High Court on 07.11.2023 and the learned Mediator shall explore the possibility for settlement of dispute between the parties and submit its report within three months from today.
List this case on 21.02.2024 along with the report of the Mediator, Mediation and Conciliation Centre, Patna High Court, Patna.

In the meantime, no coercive steps shall be taken against the petitioner No.1 in connection with Complaint Case No. 93 of 2021/ Reg. No. 1814 of 2022 pending in the court of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Kaimur at Bhabua.
